title: Generic coordinate counit compatibility
statement: Let A, B, A0, B0 be categories, F:B→A and R:A→B with adjunction adj, and F0:B0→A0 and R0:A0→B0 with adjunction adj0. Let U:A→A0, V:A0→A, W:B→B0, T:B0→B have adjunctions adju:U⊣V and adjt:W⊣T with invertible units u:Id_A≅U⋙V and s:Id_B≅W⋙T. Suppose a:W⋙F0≅F⋙U and v:T⋙F≅F0⋙V, and let e(K)=u.inv(K), t(M)=s.inv(M). Assume v(W M);V(a(M));e(F M)=F(t(M)) for every M:B. Let b:R≅U⋙R0⋙T satisfy b(K)=R(u.hom(K));d(U K), where d is the conjugate of a under adj.comp adju and adjt.comp adj0. Then F(b(K));v(R0(U K));V(adj0.counit(U K));e(K)=adj.counit(K) for every K:A.

source.place: conjugateEquiv_counit, with adjunction naturality and triangle identities; Stacks Tag 08HY, Remark 20.28.3

proof.text: Expand the composite conjugate-counit equation for d. Naturality of the two invertible units and of v, followed by the two right triangle identities, reduces the composite beginning with F(d) to adj.counit(V(U K)) followed by u.inv(K). Use the comparison cancellation at R(V(U K)) to cancel the source unit. Insert the defining component of b and use counit naturality and u.hom_inv_id to obtain the assertion. The Lean proof carries out these identities explicitly.

proof_origin.place: Explicit conjugateEquiv_counit calculation with equivalence units

theorem coordinate_counit_compatibility
    {A B A0 B0 : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category A0] [Category B0]
    (F : B ⥤ A) (R : A ⥤ B) (F0 : B0 ⥤ A0) (R0 : A0 ⥤ B0)
    (U : A ⥤ A0) (V : A0 ⥤ A) (W : B ⥤ B0) (T : B0 ⥤ B)
    (adj : F ⊣ R) (adj0 : F0 ⊣ R0) (adju : U ⊣ V) (adjt : W ⊣ T)
    (u : 𝟭 A ≅ U ⋙ V) (s : 𝟭 B ≅ W ⋙ T)
    (hu : adju.unit = u.hom) (hs : adjt.unit = s.hom)
    (a : W ⋙ F0 ≅ F ⋙ U)
    (v : T ⋙ F ≅ F0 ⋙ V)
    (e : ∀ K : A, V.obj (U.obj K) ⟶ K)
    (t : ∀ M : B, T.obj (W.obj M) ⟶ M)
    (he : ∀ K : A, e K = u.inv.app K)
    (ht : ∀ M : B, t M = s.inv.app M)
    (hc : ∀ M : B, v.hom.app (W.obj M) ≫
      V.map (a.hom.app M) ≫ e (F.obj M) = F.map (t M))
    (b : R ≅ U ⋙ R0 ⋙ T)
    (hb : ∀ K : A, b.hom.app K = R.map (u.hom.app K) ≫
      (conjugateIsoEquiv (adj.comp adju)
        (adjt.comp adj0) a).hom.app (U.obj K))
    (K : A) :
    F.map (b.hom.app K) ≫
      v.hom.app (R0.obj (U.obj K)) ≫
      V.map (adj0.counit.app (U.obj K)) ≫ e K =
      adj.counit.app K
